Can GenStone panels be installed over drywall? Yes. GenStone panels can typically be installed directly over drywall for interior projects as long as the wall structure is sound. Panels are attached to wall studs or other secure mounting points. Brian Cassel Senior Project Coordinator Can I install GenStone panels myself? Yes. GenStone panels are specifically designed for DIY installation. Many homeowners complete projects like accent walls, fireplaces, and garage facades without hiring a contractor. Amanda Lombard Director Is GenStone real stone? GenStone panels are molded from real stone to capture authentic texture and depth, but they are made from durable high-density polyurethane. This allows them to look like real masonry while remaining lightweight and easy to install. Zach Erhardt Manager How realistic do GenStone panels look? GenStone panels are cast from real stone molds to replicate natural textures and shadow lines. Once installed, most people cannot tell the difference between GenStone and traditional masonry.
